description: React component for managing vector stores, including listing, creating, viewing, editing, and deleting vector stores with associated UI elements and network calls.

classes.name: VectorStoreProps
classes.description: Props interface for VectorStoreManagement component, including accessToken, userID, and userRole.

methods.name: fetchVectorStores
methods.description: Fetches list of vector stores from backend and updates state.

methods.name: fetchCredentials
methods.description: Fetches list of credentials from backend and updates state.

methods.name: handleRefreshClick
methods.description: Handles refresh button click, fetches data and updates lastRefreshed timestamp.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Prepares to delete a vector store by setting state and opening modal.

methods.name: handleView
methods.description: Sets selected vector store for viewing.

methods.name: handleEdit
methods.description: Sets selected vector store for editing.

methods.name: handleCloseInfo
methods.description: Closes vector store info view and refreshes list.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms deletion of vector store, calls delete API, and updates UI.

methods.name: handleCreateSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful creation of a vector store, refreshes list.
